title: A lexicon traced over time — phonetic language as the record of growing conceptual understanding
note: An authored map, a proxy carrying its provenance, not a real philology. Each lexeme is a concept a culture deemed worth a word (its `valued_for` — the phonetic echo of the breath regime's `committed_because`). `alignment` places it on the sieve->success axis: 0 = sieve-aligned (a discriminating filter on raw experience — concrete necessity, what must be told apart to survive), 1 = success-aligned (abstract, experiential, aspirational — what a thriving society values). `experiential` marks a word for an inner state. `defined_in_terms_of` names the prior words a later word is built from — the definitional web whose coherence rises as understanding deepens. Years and eras are coarse and illustrative; languages are tagged so the concepts one tongue valued enough to name (and others did not) can be seen.

lexemes.valued_for: to tell life-giving water from all the rest
to hold the warming and the dangerous in one name
to mark instantly what must be fled
to tell one's own from the stranger

lexemes.gloss: what is buried to return manyfold
lexemes.valued_for: to name what is given to the ground to return
to name the time to plant and the time to reap
to name the gathered return of the seed

lexemes.gloss: the marked edge of what is one's own
lexemes.valued_for: to fix the edge of what is held

lexemes.gloss: what is owed and must be returned
lexemes.valued_for: to bind a promise of return across time
to name the passing apart from any one season

lexemes.gloss: that from which a thing follows
lexemes.valued_for: to name why a thing comes to be
to name the balance owed between people
to name a goodness one can cultivate
to name the inner life that is not the body

lexemes.gloss: a longing for an absent, perhaps unrecoverable beloved or time
lexemes.valued_for: a tongue naming a sweet, aching longing worth keeping whole

lexemes.gloss: the reflexive I that regards itself
lexemes.valued_for: to name the I that can turn and look at itself

lexemes.gloss: a valued sorrow without an object
lexemes.valued_for: to name a sorrow worth dwelling in, not only fleeing

lexemes.gloss: the ache for a lost time or home
lexemes.valued_for: to name homesickness for a time as much as a place
to name self-rule worth defending

lexemes.gloss: awe at the overwhelming and vast
lexemes.valued_for: to name a terror transfigured into awe

lexemes.gloss: estrangement from self, others, and work
lexemes.valued_for: to name a modern estrangement so it could be seen

lexemes.gloss: I am because we are — personhood through others
lexemes.valued_for: a tongue naming the self as made by its bonds

lexemes.gloss: the wordless shared look of two who each wish the other would begin
lexemes.valued_for: a tongue naming a precise, fleeting shared moment
to name the reaching of one inner life into another
a tongue naming a cosiness worth building a life around
to name the felt state of total absorption

lexemes.gloss: flourishing as a state one can seek and measure
lexemes.valued_for: to name flourishing itself as a thing to pursue
